'''Bildogs''' were oceanic, edible herd beast of [[Chad/Legends|Chadra]]. The animals were large sea slugs that would gather in groups of five to fifty. They could grow over 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and 15 meters in diameter. The species was considered graceful and gentle, but extremely dumb. They were not aggressive, and would flee attacks, depending on their thick layer of sub-dermal fatty tissue to act as armor.<ref name="AJ10" />
